purpose: Localize the sole surviving Repair07 Stage-A defect before changing any equation, sign, solver, threshold or reduced model.
questions_in_order: Does the frozen GE15+GE18 reduced initial surface satisfy the GE06+GE07 shift constraint before time marching?
Does the frozen GE15 gravitational+AeST shift contribution cancel the exact full-standard CLASS momentum contribution on the same 64-node window?
How much of the shift defect is introduced by replacing the full standard sector with the GE18 pressureless surrogate?
If the initial surface closes, at what redshift does the canonical Repair07 trajectory first exceed the unchanged 1e-6 shift gate?
Do hypothetical matter-sign or AeST-scalar-sign flips improve the initial shift residual enough to identify a convention error?
permitted_operations: read the frozen GE15 dense trace and raw CLASS perturbation/background outputs already used by GE18
read the frozen GE18 Repair01 NPZ
reuse Repair07 frozen GE06/GE07 stable generator and canonical functions without modification
evaluate shift contributions on frozen reference and Repair07 canonical trajectories
evaluate hypothetical sign flips only as non-science counterfactual diagnostics
report initial, maximum and final shift residuals and their redshift locations
explicit_nonchanges: no GE06 or GE07 source-generator edit
no GE15 or GE18 map edit
no Stage-A or Stage-B science execution

routing_logic.initial_surface_defect: current reduced initial shift backward error > 1e-6
routing_logic.propagation_defect: current reduced initial shift backward error <= 1e-6 and Repair07 canonical trajectory later exceeds 1e-6
routing_logic.matter_sign_suspect: initial_surface_defect and hypothetical T/matter-sign flip improves initial pair residual by >=100x
routing_logic.aest_scalar_sign_suspect: initial_surface_defect and hypothetical AeST scalar-phi sign flip improves initial pair residual by >=100x
routing_logic.reduced_dust_systematic_suspect: full-standard CLASS momentum cancels frozen GE15 gravitational+AeST shift to <=1e-4 while the reduced-dust reference does not
routing_logic.background_or_constraint_propagation_sus: initial surface closes, full-standard convention closes, but the internally evolved reduced trajectory later violates shift
